label: Two supplied Boolean-scenario Exercises have identical occurrence tables for both public input…
description: A strengthened #744 single-source Exercise and the #735 plural-source Exercise give identical public a,b,target occurrence tables on every Bool-pair scenario, with all records jointly sufficient, actual coherence, indispensable target contributors, and inductive Supply of every event. The strengthened single exercise has a scenario-sufficient common source and a least graph event; the plural exercise has neither. The original single exercise fails root-to-contributor record sufficiency, establishing why the strengthening matters. Different hidden carriers and record graphs are admitted. This shows that the selected public response and record-sufficiency tests do not identify graph source count; it establishes neither causation-as-production nor existential explanatory adequacy, metaphysical possibility, or a discharged root premise.
